params.body: ## What The headers of the seven subpages, as the designer drew them in the header maquette of 30 October 2026 (seven pages, one per subpage), with her pictures. - **Posts, Trends, Services, Pricing, AI tools:** her narrow picture on the left with the page name on it in orange, the heading in Newsreader in the middle with the name large and pale behind it, and her wide picture on the right running into the edge of the screen. The two pictures are two halves of one collage. Services, Pricing and AI tools also carry the page name small at the foot, as drawn. - **Reports and Contact:** the heading on the left, one picture on the right. One component, ``, replaces the black-and-white collage bands on these pages. The 404 page and the trend detail keep ``. ## How it holds - **Desktop (lg and up):** every measure is the 1701-wide drawing scaled to the width of the band in `cqw`, so the composition is the same at any desktop width. The band never gets lower than 380px; below about 1180 wide the pictures crop a little instead. - **Phone:** nothing is drawn, so: the left picture (or the single one) first at full width, then heading and intro. The wide picture is not shown and not fetched (its `` is an empty pixel under 1024px). - **Pictures:** AVIF and WebP at the original width and a smaller one (`bin/heroes.py` makes them from the delivery), 2.7 MB for all 48 files. Every `` carries the original's width and height, so nothing moves while they load. The originals (up to 1 MB each) are not committed. ## Decisions to know about - The copy is the site's, not the maquette's, which has typos ("Editoria", "andcustome"). - The posts header loses its "Create a free account" button: it is not drawn, and the navigation carries it. - The pictures are in colour, as drawn. `BRAND.md` said subpage headers are black and white; it now has a section on these headers. - The navigation keeps its hairline: pages 1 to 6 of the maquette don't show it, page 7 does. - Not in this PR, though the maquette pages show them under the headers: outlined pricing cards, the layout of the reports band, and no ticker under the Trends header. Those parts are untouched. ## Tests `PageHeroesTest` (5 tests): a hero on every subpage, the page's own pictures and no other page's, alt text and dimensions on every picture, every copy present, and the wide picture not fetched on a phone. Four mutations (swapped picture, missing size, empty alt, missing file) each turn it red. Full suite 543/544 locally (`BuildStampTest` fails in a worktree); Pint, ESLint and lint-tailwind pass. Checked by screenshot next to each maquette page at 1701 wide, at 1280 and at 390.
params.title: Subpage headers as drawn in the header maquette of 30 October
